div.p: Nicolás de Piérola, supreme head of the republic.

I decree: 1st.
That the paper note of obligatory circulation be received in the offices of the state at a fixed price of 12 pence for every sol. 2d.
That the issue of notes intrusted to the old committee of issue, to the amount of 60,000,000 soles, be closed, and all the superfluous notes in their possession, and the plates which have served to manufacture them, destroyed. 3d.
That a monthly sum of fifteen thousand pounds sterling, which shall be entered in the general estimates, be set aside for the exclusive purpose of redeeming an equal amount in notes, effected by the fiscal committee, created by decree of this date, independently of the extraordinary redemption of same which the government may be enabled to effect.
The secretary of state for finance and commerce is intrusted with the execution of this decree, and with its publication and circulation.

closer.dateline: Given in the government house in Lima this 14th day of January, 1880.
